newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel creates headquarters to combat terror.
newsitem.headline: Israel creates headquarters to combat terror.

text.p: Israel, on alert for a possible Islamic militant suicide attack, on Sunday created an office to coordinate the fight against terror.

"It was decided...to set up a special headquarters in the prime minister's office to fight terror which will coordinate the activities of all security branches," Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office said in a statement.
It said Reserve Major-General Meir Dagan would head the unit.

Israel earlier went on high alert, which has since been reduced, for fear of a possible attack by Palestinian militants of Islamic Jihad marking the one-year anniversary of their leader's assassination.
Islamic Jihad, responsible for a series of suicide bombings in Israel, accuses Israel of shooting Fathi Shqaqi, who was gunned down in on October 26, 1995, in Malta. His killers were never caught.
Islamic militant suicide bombings killed 59 people in February and March in the Jewish state.
